messages:
alex_peopleops: Heads-up — we need an expedited comp-band exception + early start approval for Priya (SWE-2). Hiring manager wants start 2026-06-01 instead of the normal 2026-06-15.

jess_recruiter: candidate accepted verbal. Requested base = $190,000, target TC = $220,000, sign-on = $18,000. Relocation covered separately.

nisha_manager: I'm ok with the base and sign-on to secure her — team has capacity and high urgency. Approve early start if payroll/legal can accommodate.

maria_finance: FYI — budget code ENG-PLAT-2026 will cover base through Q3. Need Finance ok for sign-on charge to hiring budget.

alex_peopleops: tagging @comp-committee for band exception (base is above SWE-2 top by $10k). Also must confirm early start align with benefits enrollment window.

comp-committee: quick note — exception for Priya reviewed. We can approve base up to $195k with a one-time approval email. Decision: APPROVED (condition: send formal offer by 2026-05-29 and cap sign-on at $20k).

jess_recruiter: thanks! I'll update offer doc. Two quick Qs: 1) can benefits enroll be backdated to 06/01? 2) payroll cutoff for June run?

maria_finance: payroll cutoff is 05/25 for June 1st benefits effective date in our system. Benefits team can backdate enrollment on early starts if paperwork is received before cutoff.

hr-bot: REMINDER: please submit the Offer Approval form: https://ok.redwood/offers/form — attach signed manager approval and comp-committee email.

alex_peopleops: I'll submit the form now with comp-committee thread. Jess, please attach manager approval screenshot and confirm candidate accepts those timelines.

jess_recruiter: attaching acceptance snippet and manager thumbs-up. Pasting offer summary below for the record:

```
Offer Summary - Priya K.
Role: SWE-2
Base: $190,000 (comp-committee approved up to $195k)
Sign-on: $18,000
Start: 2026-06-01 (early start requested)
Benefits effective: 2026-06-01 (pending payroll cutoff 05/25)
Relocation: handled outside of offer
Approval: comp-committee APPROVED (email archived)
```

nisha_manager: confirmed. I'm routing a calendar note for onboarding week 06/01-06/05.

maria_finance: finance confirms we have budget for sign-on and can route charge. Please cc payroll with final offer by 05/24.

alex_peopleops: great — next steps: 1) Jess, send formal offer with comp-committee note and sign-on capped at $20k by 05/24. 2) I will file the exception record in the People Ops folder and notify benefits/payroll. 3) team to prepare onboarding checklist for 06/01.

jess_recruiter: on it. Will update thread when offer sent. :thumbsup:

hr-bot: Offer Approval form submitted by alex_peopleops (ID: OA-2026-679).
